text_block_list.text:
After going out with Sakura Bakushin O, we 
were supposed to have dinner and go home, 
but…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I… have a restaurant I'd like to 
take you to!

I was taken along by her, accompanying her 
to…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I can't waait～! The "Deluxe" course at 
this ryokan is famous for its 
all-you-can-eat crab…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oyaoya! Trainer, you look so excited that 
you're freaking out!?
choice_data_list:
No, I was wondering if it's really alright 
to use your card…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fu-fu-fu… No need to worry! Because 
Trainer is my "special person"!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In fact, the other day I delivered an 
elderly woman to the hospital, who was 
huddled in pain…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That person turned out to be the 
proprietress of this place!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And so, as a thank you, "Please, come with 
your special someone," was the invitation 
I received!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
So go ahead and relax, please stuff 
yourself full!

I was touched by Sakura Bakushin O's 
words, and I did, indeed, relax as I 
waited for the food to be served――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oohhhhh～～! This is deliciooous～～! This 
one, that one, they all taste so 
expensive!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what do you think, what do you 
think? Is it delicious? Are you deeply 
moved!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Aaall right! Now, onto the main dish! …Is 
what I'd love to do, but――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
This crab! The way this crab is cooked is 
the only thing that, no matter how I try… 
I'm, not very good at… well……

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You're not coming out at all! You're 
hiding in your spike-y shell! That's 
unsportsmanlike!

…Definitely, the delicate task of 
extracting the crab from its shell looks 
difficult for someone as hasty and 
impatient as her.
choice_data_list: Crab is a battle of patience!
You can crack them with utensils.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Patience…! I see, now that you say that! 
Because everything can be done with 
patience, can't it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaall ri～ght! Patience is an honor roll 
student's specialty! Leave it all to me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hummmmuuuuuu～～!! Bakushin's, 
patieeeencee～～!!
(Crack! Crack, craaack!!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Wheee―w… Some way or another, I managed to 
smash all the shells.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ehhen! That's right, this is the patience 
of an honor roll student!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Come, now! Trainer, dig in! And while 
you're eating, I'll serve you another 
round!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Nonono! I have decided! That you shall 
enjoy this!

Sakura Bakushin O's offer moved me once 
again… and I decided to put my faith in 
her.

…The cracked crab shells were painful to 
the tongue, but the two of us enjoyed the 
meal together――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Haaaa～～… That food was absolutely 
delicious!
choice_data_list: Thank you for letting me enjoy it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
My pleasure! Thanks to the advice of my 
Trainer, my patience won out over the 
crabs!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: My Trainer always inspires me this way!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
If Trainer had been a classmate of mine, I 
would have even recruited Trainer to be my 
vice president!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ha… So this is how Trainer felt when you 
scouted me!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe―! Is that so, is that so～～! You're 
making me blush～.

We had both full stomachs and full hearts 
over our banquet cuisine.

I handed her a spoon made especially for 
cracking crabs――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ohhhh～～!? That stubborn crab broke apart 
so easily!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Then, leave the peeling to me! Please do 
enjoy the fruits of my labor, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Nonono! I have decided! That you shall 
enjoy this!

Sakura Bakushin O's offer moved me once 
again… and I decided to put my faith in 
her.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
(Chew, chew!) Ah, here comes the next 
crab! Mr. Crab, so hefty! 
Bakushinbakushin!

…Her crab-handling was too fast, and I had 
to eat an absurd amont of food, but we 
enjoyed our dinner――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Haaaa～～… That food was absolutely 
delicious!
choice_data_list: Thank you for letting me enjoy it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No, no! I'm the one who wants to thank 
you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Trainer, I have now gained 
another Bakushin speciality of mine!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Please continue to teach me so much! And――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I hope you'll continue to, as an important 
person in my life, polish my Bakushin 
together with me!

We had both full stomachs and full hearts 
over our banquet cuisine.
